scope: All tracked HTML outside answers/ and jesus-christ/: 25 files, 21 canonical authored pages and 4 noncanonical support pages; no HTML redirects in this scope.
method: Read complete extracted page prose and navigation in ordered batches, including long studies, optional reflection content and additional list/table content.
Parsed every local HTML destination and static fragment in the assigned main content; no missing files or fragments.
Reconciled file inventory against git tracked routes and sitemap.
Evaluated beginner entry, topic selection, reading sequence, source invitations, closing actions and return routes.
limitations: No local browser automation or rendered interaction by this reviewer. Parent owns rendered responsiveness, runtime panels and end-to-end interaction evidence.
This is a journey/cohesion review, not fresh external verification of every historical, doctrinal, media or time-sensitive claim.
Search, gallery, weekly lesson, Ask and player runtime content require parent browser verification; static scaffolding and recovery paths were reviewed.
Technical review does not imply owner aesthetic approval.
